_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 59: 28-30 April 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told he can tell the people what is coming, and says that as he looked over he saw that big thing and saw great financial stimulation coming to make things happy and pull people out of the funk.
mentions.quote: I saw great financial stimulation coming
mentions.falsify_match: A stimulus programme announced.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Same shape as the shallow wave from December: good numbers confirm the stimulation, bad ones confirm that it was only a rally.

mentions.claim_text: They discuss a date and he says maybe May 10th or something like that, some time in May, and notes the man was not pro crypto or anything as far as he understood.
mentions.quote: maybe like May 10th or something like that
mentions.falsify_match: Something on or near 10 May.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing. The date is guessed aloud rather than given, and he says so.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are anticipating being in that place of overflow physically, spiritually and financially, that they will get a bus and travel all over, that he cannot wait, and mentions California and Azusa Street being all over the place.
mentions.quote: Azusa Street's all over the place
mentions.falsify_match: Revival outbreaks on the Azusa Street scale in multiple places.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The benchmark is named, which is more than most of the revival material offers.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has so much joy because he knows what he was told today and has such anticipation, that he feels like a kid at Christmas, and that something big is about to happen for the body of Christ.
mentions.quote: I feel like a kid at Christmas. Something big is about to happen
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: something big with no content and no date.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of a parting in the middle of the summer, and of seeing the cankerworm and the devourer eating those around them while they flourish and their vine thrives.
mentions.quote: Parting in the middle of the summer
mentions.falsify_match: A division or turning point in midsummer.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing notable. Parting is not defined, and the exemption clause is doing the usual work: loss falls around them, not on them.

mentions.claim_text: He says they may be walking in as a rascal with a bad attitude right now but to be thankful they have that to pray for rather than the alternative, that it is rough some days, and not to curse them with your mouth but bless them.
mentions.quote: don't curse them with your mouth. Bless them
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He thanks God that he is able and will give them the desires of their heart, and that if their heart desires a godly woman or a godly man God will give them that.
mentions.quote: He'll give you the desires of your heart
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable in practice.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says to get spiritual help from the Holy Ghost as well and get into the word because the truth you know will set you free, asks whether it is God's will for them to be on that for the rest of their life and says he does not believe that.
mentions.quote: Is it God's will for you to be on that the rest of your life?
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and worth flagging: it questions long-term medication from the pulpit while telling them to also get spiritual help.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw three days concerning that gout, that it is a process and the Lord said three days, that he sees this one particular individual and it may not be for everybody but for one person in particular he sees a three day window.
mentions.quote: I saw 3 days concerning that gout. The Lord said, 3 days
mentions.falsify_match: A specific person's gout resolving within three days.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Unusually testable for a healing word: one person, one condition, three days. Only the person can report it.

mentions.claim_text: He describes painful periods severe enough to curl up in a fetal position and feel stabbed, says this is not God but part of the curse, and that Christ has redeemed them from it.
mentions.quote: This is not God. This is part of the curse
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it makes a common medical condition a spiritual failure to claim redemption from.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He dates something on Iraq to March 19th of 2003 and says it was close, that he saw that demonic principality losing a stronghold, and that he saw buildings rising up and palm trees and it becoming like Saudi Arabia with major infrastructure.
mentions.quote: I saw that demonic principality losing a stronghold
mentions.falsify_match: Large-scale construction and development in Iraq.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Becoming like Saudi Arabia is a comparison rather than a threshold.

mentions.claim_text: He refers to a fire with toxic fumes and says another one, asks whether it is coincidence and answers that he thinks not, and says this is why the Lord said to pray over Tuttle, over Louisiana and over Houston because they are targets.
mentions.quote: Pray over Tuttle. Pray over Louisiana. Pray over Houston. For they are targets
mentions.falsify_match: Industrial fires or attacks at those three places.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He treats a second chemical fire as confirmation, which is a common enough class of accident that the base rate matters.

mentions.claim_text: He says to look at that and asks whether they remember he told them he saw a rock headed their way, says he did not know this, and reads that a newly discovered asteroid designated 2026 HZ4 passed closer than the satellites two days ago and is a few metres wide.
mentions.quote: Do you remember I told you I saw a rock headed
mentions.falsify_match: A real and dated close approach offered as fulfilment. Whether a prior telling describes a rock is checkable in this corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such prior telling. Small asteroids pass inside satellite orbits regularly, which the passage does not mention.

mentions.claim_text: He says they have record rainfall in one hour, that this is weaponising weather and he told them they will weaponise weather in the days ahead, that this is not normal, and reads that a city in southern China got over 160 millimetres of rain in an hour, shattering the local April record.
mentions.quote: This is weaponizing weather. I told you they will weaponize weather
mentions.falsify_match: A rainfall record broken, which happened. Whether it was weaponised is the part that cannot be shown.
mentions.falsify_miss: The event is real and the attribution is the claim. Recorded with that distinction intact.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw them starting to sting her and said her days are almost done, that the Lord said fraud and brought it all up, and points to a fraud investigation with the FBI helping.
mentions.quote: I said, Her days are almost done. And the Lord said fraud
mentions.falsify_match: A fraud investigation touching the unnamed woman. He offers one as the fulfilment, so the earlier tellings and the investigation can both be checked.
mentions.falsify_miss: The investigation does not involve her. Eight tellings in and she has still never been named.

mentions.claim_text: He says that after telling Braden they were studying it as a flesh and he was in that raft, the Lord showed him while praying how close they truly are to the coming, and where they are going into Rosh Hashanah and 9/11, which starts at sundown of 9/11.
mentions.quote: going into Rosh Hashanah. 9/11. It starts at sundown of 9/11
mentions.falsify_match: Something on 11 September 2026, which is when Rosh Hashanah begins that year.
mentions.falsify_miss: The date passes quietly. The calendar coincidence is real and checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He says everybody is human and nobody knows the pressure of leading the United States unless they are president, and that he saw the pressure of the position and that it was not only about leading the free world.
mentions.quote: nobody knows the pressure of leading the United States of America
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is unusually sympathetic framing ahead of whatever follows.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw great responsibility come upon people who were not ready for it, that with the pressure of something so big it was not just about America but about the end times, and notes the president is old.
mentions.quote: I saw great responsibility come upon people that weren't ready for it
mentions.falsify_match: A successor taking office unprepared.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Noting his age immediately after the pressure material is worth recording alongside the lives-or-goes-home claim from March.

mentions.claim_text: He says that if God tells them to bless somebody along the way they should bless them, imagines the objection that it is a lot of money, and says he has said over and over that he will deny him nothing.
mentions.quote: That's a lot of money, Lord. I'll deny him nothing
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says it will look like a wave happening all at once with so many different avenues happening that it will look like open doors, tells them to pray for the month of May and the rest of this week, and to watch the housing market.
mentions.quote: It will look like a wave happens all at once
mentions.falsify_match: A cluster of financial or housing developments in May.
mentions.falsify_miss: A quiet May. This is the third thing hung on May, after the interest rates and the Fed chair's term.

mentions.claim_text: They sort out who is speaking first and he greets the audience, thanking them for joining.
mentions.quote: Well, good evening, family. Praise the Lord
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: a greeting.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He describes a long table where they were talking and he saw point two five, then heard them saying they must stimulate the economy or they are going to have a landslide blue victory come November, and could hear them strategising how to stimulate it.
mentions.quote: We must stimulate the economy or we are going to have a landslide blue victory
mentions.falsify_match: A quarter point rate cut ahead of the midterms.
mentions.falsify_miss: No cut of that size. The 0.25 figure is specific and checkable against published decisions, which is rare here.

mentions.claim_text: He says massive principalities have a plan and were having a meeting and strategising, notes that Satan cannot be everywhere at once and is only in one place at a time, and that he saw him strategising how they can try to overthrow.
mentions.quote: Satan can't be everywhere at once. He's only there in one place
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an unobservable meeting.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He plays a report that Denver needs more water and must conserve everything it can, that they are moving water to Cheeseman Reservoir where it evaporates more slowly, and that this will save enough for about fifteen thousand households.
mentions.quote: Denver water needs more water. They need to conserve everything that they can
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: a played news report about a real water shortage.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: The report continues that things in the bottom of the lake will be bone dry skeletons by next year, and a fishing guide says he is running free trips so people can enjoy the water while it is still there.
mentions.quote: They're going to be bone dry skeletons by next year
mentions.falsify_match: The reservoir emptying by 2027, which is a forecast made by the people in the report rather than by him.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not empty.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will see an acceleration going through this summer, through May, June and July, that he is looking through it to August and to when they get to Rosh Hashanah, and then September the 11th and that timeframe.
mentions.quote: You're going to see an acceleration going through May, June, July
mentions.falsify_match: A visibly faster tempo across the summer.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Acceleration still has no threshold, and it now runs from April through September.
